items.title: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard charts, ending major disagreement
items.summary: YouTube will resume sharing streaming data with Billboard in 2027 after changes to the chart formula give more weight to free, ad-supported music streams.
items.creator: Lauren Forristal

items.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
items.summary: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.
items.creator: Russell Brandom

items.title: AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
items.summary: Nominal, a startup that offers an AI platform for hardware engineering and claims Anduril as a major customer, has raised another big round of financing that triples its valuation.
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: France blames Iran for mass-hacks targeting freezers in grocery stores and blood banks
items.summary: France's foreign minister blamed Iran for launching at least two waves of cyberattacks targeting industrial refrigerated and freezer units across France and wider Europe.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker
